title: AN ORDINANCE REGULATING COMMERCIAL SAND AND GRAVEL EXTRACTION, SAFEGUARDING RIVERBANKS, AND ESTABLISHING QUARRY PERMITTING IN DAVAO CITY
committee: Committee on Environment and Natural Resources, Sangguniang Panlungsod

physical_specs.paper_size: Legal / Folio (8.5 x 13.0 inches / 215.9 x 330.2 mm)
physical_specs.margins: Top 1.0 in, Bottom 1.0 in, Left 1.5 in, Right 1.0 in
physical_specs.typography: 12pt Arial, 1.5 line spacing, formal section bold caps
physical_specs.enacting_clause: BE IT ORDAINED BY THE SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF DAVAO CITY, IN SESSION ASSEMBLED

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be cited as the 'Davao City Sustainable Quarrying and River Protection Ordinance of 2026'.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: The City Government balances local construction material needs with ecological preservation of vital river ecosystems under Republic Act No. 7942 and Section 16 of Republic Act No. 7160.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7942 §43; Republic Act No. 7160 §16
sections.legal_rationale: Harmonious balance of quarrying regulation with national mining statute.

sections.text: 'Quarry Resources' refers to common rocks, sand, gravel, and earth materials. 'Commercial Sand and Gravel Permit' refers to a license granted for extraction not exceeding five (5) hectares.
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Adapts national definitions from RA 7942 Section 43.

sections.text: Extraction of sand and gravel is strictly prohibited within one hundred (100) meters upstream and downstream of any bridge, water intake, or public flood control structure.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Presidential Decree No. 1067 §51; Republic Act No. 7942 §43
sections.legal_rationale: Implements national Water Code river protection setbacks.

sections.text: Commercial quarry permits within five (5) hectares shall be evaluated by the City Mining Regulatory Board (CMRB) and approved by the City Mayor.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7076 §24; Republic Act No. 7942 §43
sections.legal_rationale: Follows the exact statutory delegation under Section 43 of RA 7942.

sections.text: The Sangguniang Panlungsod is hereby empowered to issue local extraction permits for heavy metallic minerals (including nickel, copper, and gold) across ancestral domain lands, authorizing direct commercial export overseas without securing a Mineral Production Sharing Agreement (MPSA) from the DENR or clearance from the NCIP.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: 1987 Constitution Art. XII §2; Republic Act No. 7942 §27; Republic Act No. 8371 §59
sections.legal_rationale: Directly violates the Regalian Doctrine (State ownership of metallic mineral resources), Republic Act No. 7942 which reserves mineral agreements strictly to national DENR authority, and Republic Act No. 8371 (IPRA) Free Prior Informed Consent mandates.

sections.text: All trucks transporting quarried aggregates within Davao City must carry a valid Delivery Receipt issued by the City Environment Office indicating the volume and extraction site.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: Permittees shall post an environmental rehabilitation deposit prior to the commencement of extraction operations.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: No quarrying operations shall be conducted between 6:00 PM and 6:00 AM.
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Local police power operating hours regulation.

sections.text: Illegal extraction shall result in a fine of P5,000.00 and impoundment of transport vehicles.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: Invalidity of any section shall not affect other portions.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: All inconsistent local rules are repealed.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: This Ordinance takes effect thirty (30) days from publication.
sections.label: Neutral
